stem.zh: 阅读产后行为健康病历，并回答病例题。

title.en: Postpartum Depression With Intrusive Thoughts of Infant Harm
title.zh: 产后抑郁伴关于伤害婴儿的侵入性想法

summary.en: A 29-year-old primipara is evaluated six weeks after an uncomplicated vaginal birth after screening positive for postpartum depression. She is breastfeeding, recently started sertraline, and reports distressing unwanted thoughts about accidental harm to her infant while maintaining reality testing and denying intent.
summary.zh: 一名29岁初产妇在无并发症阴道分娩后6周接受评估，产后抑郁筛查阳性。她正在母乳喂养，最近开始服用舍曲林，并报告关于婴儿意外受伤的痛苦、非自愿想法；她现实检验能力完整，并否认有伤害意图。

content.en:
Age: 29 years
Obstetric history: G1P1, uncomplicated full-term vaginal delivery 6 weeks ago
Infant: healthy male, exclusively breastfed
Psychiatric history: no prior diagnosis; mother has history of major depressive disorder
Substance use: none reported
Living situation: lives with partner, who works full-time during the day
Six-week postpartum visit: EPDS 19/30; denied suicidal ideation on screening; endorsed self-blame and anxiety/worry items
Current treatment: sertraline 50 mg PO daily started 5 days ago by obstetrician; referred for cognitive-behavioral therapy and behavioral health intake
content.zh:
年龄：29岁
产科史：G1P1，6周前足月阴道分娩，无并发症
婴儿：健康男婴，纯母乳喂养
精神科病史：既往无诊断；母亲有重性抑郁障碍史
物质使用：未报告
居住情况：与伴侣同住，伴侣白天全职工作
产后6周复诊：EPDS 19/30；筛查时否认自杀意念；自责和无明显原因焦虑/担忧项目阳性
目前治疗：产科医生5天前开具舍曲林50 mg口服每日一次；已转介认知行为治疗和行为健康初诊

title.zh: 行为健康初诊：初始表现

content.en: Arrives holding the infant in a car seat. Appears fatigued, with flat affect, minimal eye contact, and low monotone speech. Reports poor sleep even when the infant sleeps, persistent feelings of inadequacy as a mother, and says she "can't stop the bad thoughts." When asked to elaborate, she becomes tearful and says she keeps imagining dropping the baby down the stairs. She says the thought horrifies her, states she would never hurt the baby, and reports avoiding carrying the infant near the staircase.
content.zh: 来诊时婴儿在汽车安全座椅中。患者显得疲惫，情感平淡，眼神接触少，说话声音低且单调。她报告即使婴儿睡觉时自己也睡不好，持续觉得自己不是合格的母亲，并说“我停不下那些坏念头”。进一步询问时，她流泪说自己反复想象把婴儿从楼梯上摔下去。她表示这个想法让她非常恐惧，说明自己绝不会伤害婴儿，并报告避免抱婴儿靠近楼梯。

title.en: Assessment findings and recent laboratory results
title.zh: 评估发现和近期实验室结果

content.en:
Mental status: oriented to person, place, time, and situation; coherent and goal-directed speech; no disorganized or delusional thinking; no psychomotor agitation.
Thought content: identifies the harm thoughts as her own unwanted thoughts, not voices or commands; denies desire, plan, or intent to act on them.
Safety: denies suicidal ideation, homicidal ideation, or intent to harm herself or the infant. C-SSRS: no lifetime or recent suicidal ideation; no suicidal behavior.
Mood/function: mood 2/10, anhedonia, guilt about not feeling bonded, poor appetite, 4 kg weight loss beyond expected postpartum loss.
PHQ-9: 18.
Vital signs: T 36.8 C, HR 78, BP 118/72, RR 16, SpO2 99% on room air.
Laboratory results from postpartum visit: TSH 2.4 mIU/L, hemoglobin 12.1 g/dL, CBC within normal limits, CMP unremarkable.
content.zh:
精神状态：人、地、时间、情境定向力完整；言语连贯且有目标；无思维紊乱或妄想；无精神运动性激越。
思维内容：她认为伤害相关想法是自己不想要的想法，不是声音或命令；否认有欲望、计划或意图去实施。
安全：否认自杀意念、他杀意念，否认有伤害自己或婴儿的意图。C-SSRS：既往和近期均无自杀意念；无自杀行为。
情绪/功能：心情2/10，快感缺失，对未能与婴儿建立亲密感到内疚，食欲差，超过预期产后体重下降4 kg。
PHQ-9：18分。
生命体征：体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率78次/分，血压118/72 mmHg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 99%。
产后复诊实验室结果：TSH 2.4 mIU/L，血红蛋白12.1 g/dL，CBC在正常范围内，综合代谢面板无明显异常。

title.en: Stage 1 - Initial behavioral health intake, day 5 of sertraline
title.zh: 阶段1——行为健康初诊，舍曲林第5天
结构化安全与风险评估

content.en: The nurse assesses suicidal ideation, intent or plan, thoughts of harming the infant, psychosis, command hallucinations, ability to care for the infant, and home support. After this assessment, the client discloses the intrusive thought about dropping the baby, avoidance around the staircase, and intense distress about the thoughts. She is tearful but engaged. She reports sleeping 2-3 fragmented hours per night even when the infant sleeps 4-5 hour stretches. She has not yet attended therapy. She is taking sertraline as prescribed, feels no difference yet, and denies side effects. Repeat EPDS: 20. She fears that if she discloses the thoughts, her baby will be taken away.
content.zh: 护士评估自杀意念、意图或计划、伤害婴儿的想法、精神病性症状、命令性幻听、照护婴儿的能力以及家庭支持。完成此评估后，患者披露关于把婴儿摔下去的侵入性想法、围绕楼梯的回避行为，以及这些想法带来的强烈痛苦。她流泪但能参与交流。她报告每晚仅断续睡2到3小时，即使婴儿能连续睡4到5小时。她尚未开始治疗。她按医嘱服用舍曲林，目前还没感觉改善，并否认副作用。复测EPDS：20分。她担心如果说出这些想法，孩子会被带走。

content.en: The client's mother, who is visiting for the week, tells the nurse privately that her daughter "hasn't been herself" and that she found her crying in the bathroom at 3 AM two nights ago because she "couldn't turn off her brain." The mother asks whether the intrusive thoughts mean her daughter is dangerous to the infant.
content.zh: 患者的母亲本周来探访，她私下告诉护士，女儿“和平时不一样”，两天前凌晨3点她发现女儿在浴室哭泣，原因是“脑子停不下来”。母亲询问这些侵入性想法是否意味着女儿对婴儿有危险。

title.en: Stage 2 - Two-week follow-up, day 19 of sertraline
title.zh: 阶段2——两周随访，舍曲林第19天

content.en: The client returns alone with the infant. She reports sertraline "might be helping a little": sleep is 3-4 hours per night and appetite is slightly better. Intrusive thoughts have not diminished and now include imagining the infant choking. She checks the infant's breathing every 15-20 minutes throughout the night, avoids bathing the infant alone because she imagines slipping underwater, and has not left the house alone with the infant since her mother left four days ago. She attended one telehealth CBT session and found discussion of intrusive thoughts versus intent "a little helpful." She denies suicidal ideation or intent to harm the infant. She appears anxious, fidgets, picks at her cuticles, and speaks with mild pressure when discussing the thoughts. PHQ-9: 16. EPDS: 18. Vital signs: T 36.9 C, HR 84, BP 122/76, RR 18, SpO2 99%.
content.zh: 患者独自带婴儿复诊。她报告舍曲林“可能有一点帮助”：每晚睡3到4小时，食欲稍有改善。侵入性想法没有减少，现在还包括想象婴儿窒息。她整晚每15到20分钟检查婴儿呼吸；因为会想象婴儿滑入水中而避免单独给婴儿洗澡；自4天前母亲离开后，她没有独自带婴儿出门。她参加了一次远程认知行为治疗，觉得关于侵入性想法与意图区别的讨论“有一点帮助”。她否认自杀意念或伤害婴儿意图。她看起来更焦虑，坐立不安，抠甲周皮肤，谈到这些想法时语速略快。PHQ-9：16分。EPDS：18分。生命体征：体温98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率84次/分，血压122/76 mmHg，呼吸18次/分，SpO2 99%。

content.en: The client says, "I know it doesn't make sense, but I can't stop." She reports that her partner is supportive but frustrated because she wakes him repeatedly to check the baby. She asks the nurse whether the medication dose should be increased.
content.zh: 患者说：“我知道这说不通，但我停不下来。”她报告伴侣支持她，但因为她反复叫醒他检查婴儿而感到挫败。她询问护士药物剂量是否应该增加。

title.en: Stage 3 - Five-week follow-up, day 33 of sertraline; dose 100 mg daily since day 21
title.zh: 阶段3——五周随访，舍曲林第33天；第21天起剂量为每日100 mg

content.en: The client arrives with the infant in a stroller, makes eye contact, and greets the nurse by name. She reports sleeping 5-6 hours per night, eating regular meals, and taking the infant for two walks this week. Intrusive thoughts still occur but are "quieter" and less frequent, about once or twice a day rather than constantly. She no longer avoids the staircase, though she holds the railing. She has attended three CBT sessions and states that labeling thoughts as "just thoughts, not plans" is helpful. She bathed the infant alone yesterday without significant distress. EPDS: 11. PHQ-9: 10. She smiles briefly when describing the infant grasping her finger. She and her partner have a nighttime schedule so each gets a longer sleep block. She asks how long she will need to stay on medication, whether it is still safe while breastfeeding, and whether she is at risk for recurrence with a future pregnancy. Vital signs: T 36.7 C, HR 74, BP 116/70, RR 14, SpO2 99%.
content.zh: 患者推着婴儿车来诊，有眼神接触，并能叫出护士姓名打招呼。她报告每晚睡5到6小时，规律进餐，本周带婴儿外出散步两次。侵入性想法仍会出现，但“声音小了”，频率较低，从持续不断降至每天一两次。她不再回避楼梯，但仍会扶着扶手。她已参加三次认知行为治疗，并说把想法标记为“只是想法，不是计划”很有帮助。她昨天独自给婴儿洗澡，未出现明显痛苦。EPDS：11分。PHQ-9：10分。她描述婴儿抓住她手指的新习惯时短暂微笑。她和伴侣制定了夜间安排，使双方都能获得较长睡眠时段。她询问需要服药多久、母乳喂养期间继续服药是否仍安全，以及将来再次怀孕是否有复发风险。生命体征：体温98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，心率74次/分，血压116/70 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，SpO2 99%。

stem.en: At Stage 1, classify each cue after the structured safety assessment.
stem.zh: 在阶段1完成结构化安全评估后，对每项线索进行分类。

stem.en: At Stage 1, the structured safety assessment shows no intent to harm, no psychosis, and intact ability to care for the infant. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段1，结构化安全评估显示患者无伤害意图、无精神病性症状，并且照护婴儿能力完整。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: At Stage 2, the client asks, "Should my sertraline dose be increased?" Which response by the nurse is best?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，患者问：“我的舍曲林剂量应该增加吗？”护士的哪项回应最佳？

stem.en: At Stage 3, which statements should the nurse include when evaluating the treatment response and providing anticipatory guidance? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，护士评估治疗反应并提供预期指导时，应包括哪些说明？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: At Stage 2, complete the clinical judgment statement about the symptom trajectory.
stem.zh: 在阶段2，完成关于症状变化轨迹的临床判断陈述。

clozeStem.en: The Stage 2 findings are most consistent with {{1}}; the nurse should {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 阶段2的发现最符合 {{1}}；护士应 {{2}}。

options.en: inadequate response with emerging obsessive-compulsive features and functional impairment
options.zh: 反应不足，并出现强迫相关特征和功能受损

options.en: probable sertraline adverse effect requiring the client to stop the medication immediately
options.zh: 可能是舍曲林不良反应，需要患者立即停药

options.en: adequate early response that requires only routine reassurance
options.zh: 早期反应充分，只需要常规安慰

options.en: tell the client to wait silently until the current dose works because intrusive thoughts always resolve quickly
options.zh: 告诉患者安静等待现剂量起效，因为侵入性想法总会很快消失

options.en: notify the prescribing provider with screening-score trends, functional changes, and safety assessment findings
options.zh: 将筛查分数趋势、功能变化和安全评估结果通知开药提供者

options.en: independently increase the sertraline dose because the client asked
options.zh: 因为患者询问，就由护士自行增加舍曲林剂量

correct.en: At Stage 2, depression scores and sleep have improved only slightly, while intrusive thoughts have expanded, checking has become repetitive, and avoidance now limits bathing and leaving the house. This pattern suggests undertreated symptoms with obsessive-compulsive features and functional impairment. The nurse should communicate organized assessment data to the prescriber and reinforce ongoing CBT; dose changes remain a prescriber decision.
correct.zh: 在阶段2，抑郁评分和睡眠仅轻度改善，但侵入性想法扩大，检查行为反复，回避行为已限制洗澡和出门。这种模式提示症状治疗不足，并有强迫相关特征和功能受损。护士应将有组织的评估资料传达给开药者，并强化继续认知行为治疗；剂量调整仍由开药者决定。

byChoice.en: The first dropdown should identify inadequate response because function is worsening even though screening scores improved slightly.
byChoice.zh: 第一个下拉项应识别为反应不足，因为即使筛查分数略有改善，功能仍在恶化。

byChoice.en: The second dropdown should choose provider notification with concrete data, not independent titration or passive waiting.
byChoice.zh: 第二个下拉项应选择带着具体资料通知提供者，而不是护士自行调剂量或被动等待。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not judge response by one score alone. Compare symptom intensity, function, safety, sleep, and validated tools over time.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要只凭一个评分判断治疗反应。要纵向比较症状强度、功能、安全、睡眠和量表结果。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the postpartum behavioral health record and answer the case-study items.
阅读产后行为健康病历，并回答病例题。
Postpartum Depression With Intrusive Thoughts of Infant Harm
产后抑郁伴关于伤害婴儿的侵入性想法

A 29-year-old primipara is evaluated six weeks after an uncomplicated vaginal birth after screening positive for postpartum depression. She is breastfeeding, recently started sertraline, and reports distressing unwanted thoughts about accidental harm to her infant while maintaining reality testing and denying intent.
一名29岁初产妇在无并发症阴道分娩后6周接受评估，产后抑郁筛查阳性。她正在母乳喂养，最近开始服用舍曲林，并报告关于婴儿意外受伤的痛苦、非自愿想法；她现实检验能力完整，并否认有伤害意图。

Age: 29 years
Obstetric history: G1P1, uncomplicated full-term vaginal delivery 6 weeks ago
Infant: healthy male, exclusively breastfed
Psychiatric history: no prior diagnosis; mother has history of major depressive disorder
Substance use: none reported
Living situation: lives with partner, who works full-time during the day
Six-week postpartum visit: EPDS 19/30; denied suicidal ideation on screening; endorsed self-blame and anxiety/worry items
Current treatment: sertraline 50 mg PO daily started 5 days ago by obstetrician; referred for cognitive-behavioral therapy and behavioral health intake

年龄：29岁
产科史：G1P1，6周前足月阴道分娩，无并发症
婴儿：健康男婴，纯母乳喂养
精神科病史：既往无诊断；母亲有重性抑郁障碍史
物质使用：未报告
居住情况：与伴侣同住，伴侣白天全职工作
产后6周复诊：EPDS 19/30；筛查时否认自杀意念；自责和无明显原因焦虑/担忧项目阳性
目前治疗：产科医生5天前开具舍曲林50 mg口服每日一次；已转介认知行为治疗和行为健康初诊

Arrives holding the infant in a car seat. Appears fatigued, with flat affect, minimal eye contact, and low monotone speech. Reports poor sleep even when the infant sleeps, persistent feelings of inadequacy as a mother, and says she "can't stop the bad thoughts." When asked to elaborate, she becomes tearful and says she keeps imagining dropping the baby down the stairs. She says the thought horrifies her, states she would never hurt the baby, and reports avoiding carrying the infant near the staircase.
来诊时婴儿在汽车安全座椅中。患者显得疲惫，情感平淡，眼神接触少，说话声音低且单调。她报告即使婴儿睡觉时自己也睡不好，持续觉得自己不是合格的母亲，并说“我停不下那些坏念头”。进一步询问时，她流泪说自己反复想象把婴儿从楼梯上摔下去。她表示这个想法让她非常恐惧，说明自己绝不会伤害婴儿，并报告避免抱婴儿靠近楼梯。
行为健康初诊：初始表现

Mental status: oriented to person, place, time, and situation; coherent and goal-directed speech; no disorganized or delusional thinking; no psychomotor agitation.
Thought content: identifies the harm thoughts as her own unwanted thoughts, not voices or commands; denies desire, plan, or intent to act on them.
Safety: denies suicidal ideation, homicidal ideation, or intent to harm herself or the infant. C-SSRS: no lifetime or recent suicidal ideation; no suicidal behavior.
Mood/function: mood 2/10, anhedonia, guilt about not feeling bonded, poor appetite, 4 kg weight loss beyond expected postpartum loss.
PHQ-9: 18.
Vital signs: T 36.8 C, HR 78, BP 118/72, RR 16, SpO2 99% on room air.
Laboratory results from postpartum visit: TSH 2.4 mIU/L, hemoglobin 12.1 g/dL, CBC within normal limits, CMP unremarkable.

精神状态：人、地、时间、情境定向力完整；言语连贯且有目标；无思维紊乱或妄想；无精神运动性激越。
思维内容：她认为伤害相关想法是自己不想要的想法，不是声音或命令；否认有欲望、计划或意图去实施。
安全：否认自杀意念、他杀意念，否认有伤害自己或婴儿的意图。C-SSRS：既往和近期均无自杀意念；无自杀行为。
情绪/功能：心情2/10，快感缺失，对未能与婴儿建立亲密感到内疚，食欲差，超过预期产后体重下降4 kg。
PHQ-9：18分。
生命体征：体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率78次/分，血压118/72 mmHg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 99%。
产后复诊实验室结果：TSH 2.4 mIU/L，血红蛋白12.1 g/dL，CBC在正常范围内，综合代谢面板无明显异常。
Assessment findings and recent laboratory results
评估发现和近期实验室结果

The nurse assesses suicidal ideation, intent or plan, thoughts of harming the infant, psychosis, command hallucinations, ability to care for the infant, and home support. After this assessment, the client discloses the intrusive thought about dropping the baby, avoidance around the staircase, and intense distress about the thoughts. She is tearful but engaged. She reports sleeping 2-3 fragmented hours per night even when the infant sleeps 4-5 hour stretches. She has not yet attended therapy. She is taking sertraline as prescribed, feels no difference yet, and denies side effects. Repeat EPDS: 20. She fears that if she discloses the thoughts, her baby will be taken away.

护士评估自杀意念、意图或计划、伤害婴儿的想法、精神病性症状、命令性幻听、照护婴儿的能力以及家庭支持。完成此评估后，患者披露关于把婴儿摔下去的侵入性想法、围绕楼梯的回避行为，以及这些想法带来的强烈痛苦。她流泪但能参与交流。她报告每晚仅断续睡2到3小时，即使婴儿能连续睡4到5小时。她尚未开始治疗。她按医嘱服用舍曲林，目前还没感觉改善，并否认副作用。复测EPDS：20分。她担心如果说出这些想法，孩子会被带走。
结构化安全与风险评估

The client's mother, who is visiting for the week, tells the nurse privately that her daughter "hasn't been herself" and that she found her crying in the bathroom at 3 AM two nights ago because she "couldn't turn off her brain." The mother asks whether the intrusive thoughts mean her daughter is dangerous to the infant.
患者的母亲本周来探访，她私下告诉护士，女儿“和平时不一样”，两天前凌晨3点她发现女儿在浴室哭泣，原因是“脑子停不下来”。母亲询问这些侵入性想法是否意味着女儿对婴儿有危险。
Stage 1 - Initial behavioral health intake, day 5 of sertraline
阶段1——行为健康初诊，舍曲林第5天

The client returns alone with the infant. She reports sertraline "might be helping a little": sleep is 3-4 hours per night and appetite is slightly better. Intrusive thoughts have not diminished and now include imagining the infant choking. She checks the infant's breathing every 15-20 minutes throughout the night, avoids bathing the infant alone because she imagines slipping underwater, and has not left the house alone with the infant since her mother left four days ago. She attended one telehealth CBT session and found discussion of intrusive thoughts versus intent "a little helpful." She denies suicidal ideation or intent to harm the infant. She appears anxious, fidgets, picks at her cuticles, and speaks with mild pressure when discussing the thoughts. PHQ-9: 16. EPDS: 18. Vital signs: T 36.9 C, HR 84, BP 122/76, RR 18, SpO2 99%.

患者独自带婴儿复诊。她报告舍曲林“可能有一点帮助”：每晚睡3到4小时，食欲稍有改善。侵入性想法没有减少，现在还包括想象婴儿窒息。她整晚每15到20分钟检查婴儿呼吸；因为会想象婴儿滑入水中而避免单独给婴儿洗澡；自4天前母亲离开后，她没有独自带婴儿出门。她参加了一次远程认知行为治疗，觉得关于侵入性想法与意图区别的讨论“有一点帮助”。她否认自杀意念或伤害婴儿意图。她看起来更焦虑，坐立不安，抠甲周皮肤，谈到这些想法时语速略快。PHQ-9：16分。EPDS：18分。生命体征：体温98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率84次/分，血压122/76 mmHg，呼吸18次/分，SpO2 99%。

The client says, "I know it doesn't make sense, but I can't stop." She reports that her partner is supportive but frustrated because she wakes him repeatedly to check the baby. She asks the nurse whether the medication dose should be increased.
患者说：“我知道这说不通，但我停不下来。”她报告伴侣支持她，但因为她反复叫醒他检查婴儿而感到挫败。她询问护士药物剂量是否应该增加。
Stage 2 - Two-week follow-up, day 19 of sertraline
阶段2——两周随访，舍曲林第19天

The client arrives with the infant in a stroller, makes eye contact, and greets the nurse by name. She reports sleeping 5-6 hours per night, eating regular meals, and taking the infant for two walks this week. Intrusive thoughts still occur but are "quieter" and less frequent, about once or twice a day rather than constantly. She no longer avoids the staircase, though she holds the railing. She has attended three CBT sessions and states that labeling thoughts as "just thoughts, not plans" is helpful. She bathed the infant alone yesterday without significant distress. EPDS: 11. PHQ-9: 10. She smiles briefly when describing the infant grasping her finger. She and her partner have a nighttime schedule so each gets a longer sleep block. She asks how long she will need to stay on medication, whether it is still safe while breastfeeding, and whether she is at risk for recurrence with a future pregnancy. Vital signs: T 36.7 C, HR 74, BP 116/70, RR 14, SpO2 99%.

患者推着婴儿车来诊，有眼神接触，并能叫出护士姓名打招呼。她报告每晚睡5到6小时，规律进餐，本周带婴儿外出散步两次。侵入性想法仍会出现，但“声音小了”，频率较低，从持续不断降至每天一两次。她不再回避楼梯，但仍会扶着扶手。她已参加三次认知行为治疗，并说把想法标记为“只是想法，不是计划”很有帮助。她昨天独自给婴儿洗澡，未出现明显痛苦。EPDS：11分。PHQ-9：10分。她描述婴儿抓住她手指的新习惯时短暂微笑。她和伴侣制定了夜间安排，使双方都能获得较长睡眠时段。她询问需要服药多久、母乳喂养期间继续服药是否仍安全，以及将来再次怀孕是否有复发风险。生命体征：体温98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，心率74次/分，血压116/70 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，SpO2 99%。
Stage 3 - Five-week follow-up, day 33 of sertraline; dose 100 mg daily since day 21
阶段3——五周随访，舍曲林第33天；第21天起剂量为每日100 mg
At Stage 1, classify each cue after the structured safety assessment.
在阶段1完成结构化安全评估后，对每项线索进行分类。
At Stage 1, the structured safety assessment shows no intent to harm, no psychosis, and intact ability to care for the infant. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
在阶段1，结构化安全评估显示患者无伤害意图、无精神病性症状，并且照护婴儿能力完整。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。
At Stage 2, the client asks, "Should my sertraline dose be increased?" Which response by the nurse is best?
在阶段2，患者问：“我的舍曲林剂量应该增加吗？”护士的哪项回应最佳？
At Stage 3, which statements should the nurse include when evaluating the treatment response and providing anticipatory guidance? Select all that apply.
在阶段3，护士评估治疗反应并提供预期指导时，应包括哪些说明？选择所有适用项。
At Stage 2, complete the clinical judgment statement about the symptom trajectory.
在阶段2，完成关于症状变化轨迹的临床判断陈述。
The Stage 2 findings are most consistent with {{1}}; the nurse should {{2}}.
阶段2的发现最符合 {{1}}；护士应 {{2}}。
inadequate response with emerging obsessive-compulsive features and functional impairment
反应不足，并出现强迫相关特征和功能受损
probable sertraline adverse effect requiring the client to stop the medication immediately
可能是舍曲林不良反应，需要患者立即停药
adequate early response that requires only routine reassurance
早期反应充分，只需要常规安慰
tell the client to wait silently until the current dose works because intrusive thoughts always resolve quickly
告诉患者安静等待现剂量起效，因为侵入性想法总会很快消失
notify the prescribing provider with screening-score trends, functional changes, and safety assessment findings
将筛查分数趋势、功能变化和安全评估结果通知开药提供者
independently increase the sertraline dose because the client asked
因为患者询问，就由护士自行增加舍曲林剂量
The first dropdown should identify inadequate response because function is worsening even though screening scores improved slightly.
第一个下拉项应识别为反应不足，因为即使筛查分数略有改善，功能仍在恶化。
The second dropdown should choose provider notification with concrete data, not independent titration or passive waiting.
第二个下拉项应选择带着具体资料通知提供者，而不是护士自行调剂量或被动等待。

At Stage 2, depression scores and sleep have improved only slightly, while intrusive thoughts have expanded, checking has become repetitive, and avoidance now limits bathing and leaving the house. This pattern suggests undertreated symptoms with obsessive-compulsive features and functional impairment. The nurse should communicate organized assessment data to the prescriber and reinforce ongoing CBT; dose changes remain a prescriber decision.
在阶段2，抑郁评分和睡眠仅轻度改善，但侵入性想法扩大，检查行为反复，回避行为已限制洗澡和出门。这种模式提示症状治疗不足，并有强迫相关特征和功能受损。护士应将有组织的评估资料传达给开药者，并强化继续认知行为治疗；剂量调整仍由开药者决定。
Do not judge response by one score alone. Compare symptom intensity, function, safety, sleep, and validated tools over time.
不要只凭一个评分判断治疗反应。要纵向比较症状强度、功能、安全、睡眠和量表结果。

stem.en: Read the case study and answer the questions that follow.
stem.zh: 阅读案例研究并回答以下问题。

title.en: Advance directive clarification and code status escalation in metastatic lung cancer with acute respiratory decline.
title.zh: 伴有急性呼吸衰退的转移性肺癌中的预立医疗指示澄清和抢救状态升级。

summary.en: Mr. Harold Jeffries is a 55-year-old man admitted five days ago to a medical-surgical unit with progressive dyspnea and right-sided pleural effusion secondary to metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (stage IV). He is receiving palliative carboplatin-based chemotherapy. Current orders include supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula titrated to maintain SpO₂ > 92%. The attending is a pulmonologist currently in the OR; the covering provider is a hospitalist. The medical record contains no advance directive, POLST, or healthcare power of attorney. The code status is 'Full Code' (default). His daughter Keisha is the emergency contact. At 0700, he states unprompted: 'I've been thinking about this all night. I don't want to be kept alive by machines. If something happens, I don't want them to put a tube down my throat... I just want to be comfortable.'
summary.zh: Harold Jeffries 先生是一位 55 岁的男性，五天前因转移性非小细胞肺癌（IV期）继发的进行性呼吸困难和右侧胸腔积液收治于内外科病房。他正在接受以卡铂为基础的姑息性化疗。目前的医嘱包括通过鼻导管吸氧以维持 SpO₂ > 92%。主治医生是目前在手术室的呼吸科医生；代班医生是住院医师。病历中没有预立医疗指示、维持生命治疗医生医嘱（POLST）或医疗委托书。抢救状态为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”（默认）。他的女儿 Keisha 是紧急联系人。在 0700，他自发地说道：“我整晚都在想这件事。我不想靠机器维持生命。如果发生什么事，我不想他们把管子插进我喉咙里……我只想舒舒服服的。”

title.zh: 初步评估与实验室检查 (0700)

content.en:
Vital Signs:
Temperature: 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
Heart rate: 92 bpm
Blood pressure: 118/72 mmHg
Respiratory rate: 20 breaths/min
SpO₂: 93% on 3 L nasal cannula

Assessment:
Alert, oriented to person, place, time, situation.
Conversational, assesses with full decision-making capacity.
Respirations mildly labored with accessory muscle use at rest.
Diminished breath sounds over right lower/middle lung fields.
Scattered expiratory wheezes in left lung.
Pain: 3/10, right-sided chest wall ache.
Speaks in full sentences.

Labs (0530):
WBC: 3.8 ×10³/µL
Hemoglobin: 10.4 g/dL
Platelets: 112 ×10³/µL
BUN: 18 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Albumin: 2.6 g/dL
LDH: 680 U/L
content.zh:
生命体征：
体温：98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
心率：92 次/分
血压：118/72 mmHg
呼吸频率：20 次/分
SpO₂：3 L鼻导管吸氧下 93%

评估：
清醒，对人物、地点、时间和情况定向力良好。
能够交谈，经评估具有完全的决策能力。
静息时呼吸轻度费力，伴有辅助呼吸肌参与。
右下/中肺野呼吸音减弱。
左肺散在呼气相哮鸣音。
疼痛：3/10，右侧胸壁钝痛。
能说完整的句子。

实验室检查 (0530)：
白细胞：3.8 ×10³/µL
血红蛋白：10.4 g/dL
血小板：112 ×10³/µL
尿素氮：18 mg/dL
肌酐：0.9 mg/dL
白蛋白：2.6 g/dL
乳酸脱氢酶：680 U/L

content.en: After Mr. Jeffries clarifies he does not want endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, or CPR (but accepts oxygen and comfort meds), the nurse documents his verbatim statements and capacity. At 0745, the attending's office states he is scrubbing for a case and unavailable until 1400. The covering hospitalist, Dr. Reeves, is paged and responds at 0800: 'I am rounding on the other side of the hospital. I'll see him around 1100.' The code status remains Full Code.
content.zh: 在 Jeffries 先生明确表示他不希望进行气管插管、机械通气或心肺复苏（但接受吸氧和舒适药物）后，护士记录了他的原话及其决策能力。在 0745，主治医生的办公室表示他正在为手术刷手，直到 1400 才有空。代班住院医师 Reeves 医生被呼叫，并在 0800 回复：“我正在医院另一边查房。我大概 1100 会去看他。”抢救状态仍然是全面抢救 (Full Code)。

content.en:
At 0930, portable CXR shows a large recurrent right-sided pleural effusion with mediastinal shift and a new left pleural effusion.
At 0945, patient becomes acutely dyspneic. SpO₂ 88% on 3 L. Nurse increases O₂ to 6 L face mask; SpO₂ improves to 90%. 
At 0950, nurse pages Dr. Reeves about the acute respiratory failure and wishes against intubation. Dr. Reeves replies he will come 'as soon as I can.'
At 1030, SpO₂ is 89% on 6 L face mask, RR 30, HR 118, BP 102/64. Patient says between breaths: 'Please... don't let them... put a tube in me.' Nurse switches to non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min; SpO₂ rises to 91%.
content.zh:
在 0930，床旁胸片显示右侧胸腔积液大量复发伴纵隔移位，并出现新的左侧胸腔积液。
在 0945，患者出现急性呼吸困难。3 L吸氧下 SpO₂ 为 88%。护士将氧气增加到 6 L 面罩；SpO₂ 升至 90%。
在 0950，护士就急性呼吸衰竭和患者拒绝插管的意愿呼叫 Reeves 医生。Reeves 医生回复说他会“尽快”赶来。
在 1030，6 L面罩吸氧下 SpO₂ 为 89%，呼吸频率 30，心率 118，血压 102/64。患者喘息着说：“求你……别让他们……给我插管。”护士换用 15 L/min 的非重复呼吸面罩；SpO₂ 升至 91%。

content.en: At 1100, the nurse activates the rapid response team (RRT). The RRT arrives. Dr. Anand (critical care fellow) speaks directly to Mr. Jeffries: 'We may need to talk about a breathing tube. Can you tell me what you would want?' Mr. Jeffries responds: 'No tube. No machines. Comfortable.' Dr. Anand enters a DNAR/DNI order. By 1130, social work completes the advance directive with the daughter, palliative care consult is placed, and comfort measures (morphine, non-rebreather) are effective.
content.zh: 在 1100，护士启动了快速反应小组 (RRT)。RRT 到达。Anand 医生（重症监护专科医师）直接对 Jeffries 先生说：“我们可能需要谈谈呼吸管的事。你能告诉我你想要什么吗？”Jeffries 先生回答：“不要管子。不要机器。舒服点。”Anand 医生下达了不复苏/不插管 (DNAR/DNI) 的医嘱。到了 1130，社会工作者与女儿完成了预立医疗指示，请了姑息治疗会诊，并且舒适措施（吗啡、非重复呼吸面罩）有效。

stem.en: At 0700, what is the nurse's priority action in response to Mr. Jeffries's statement?
stem.zh: 在 0700，针对 Jeffries 先生的陈述，护士的首要行动是什么？

stem.en: At 0800, after Dr. Reeves indicates he will visit the patient around 1100, which action is most appropriate for the nurse?
stem.zh: 在 0800，当 Reeves 医生表示他将在 1100 左右探视患者后，护士最合适的行动是什么？

stem.en: By 1030, Mr. Jeffries remains hypoxemic and increasingly fatigued despite escalation of oxygen, and his code status remains 'Full Code.' Which action is correct?
stem.zh: 到了 1030，尽管增加了吸氧量，Jeffries 先生仍然存在低氧血症且越来越疲劳，其抢救状态仍为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”。哪项行动是正确的？

stem.en: At 1100, the nurse activates the rapid response team (RRT). What is essential to include in the handoff?
stem.zh: 在 1100，护士启动了快速反应小组 (RRT)。交接中必须包括什么？

options.en: The unresolved code status, the patient's expressed wishes against intubation, his assessed capacity, and the escalation history.
options.zh: 未解决的抢救状态、患者明确表示反对插管的意愿、其经评估的能力以及上报历史。

options.en: Only the clinical data, assuming the RRT physician will review the nursing notes in the chart.
options.zh: 仅包括临床数据，假设 RRT 医生会查阅病历中的护理记录。

options.en: A recommendation that the RRT stand down because the patient has verbally refused treatment.
options.zh: 因为患者已口头拒绝治疗，建议 RRT 撤退。

options.en: A request for the RRT nurse to immediately administer procedural sedation for intubation.
options.zh: 要求 RRT 护士立即给予程序性镇静以进行插管。

correct.en: The handoff must prominently feature the unresolved code status, the patient's clear refusal of intubation, capacity assessment, and escalation history. This information directly determines what the RRT can and should do.
correct.zh: 交接必须突出未解决的抢救状态、患者明确拒绝插管、能力评估和上报历史。这些信息直接决定了 RRT 可以和应该做什么。

byChoice.en: The RRT is needed because the patient requires emergency provider evaluation and symptom management (e.g., dyspnea), and the provider can formally enter the DNAR/DNI order.
byChoice.zh: 由于患者需要紧急的医生评估和症状管理（例如呼吸困难），并且有权限的医嘱开立者可以正式下达 DNAR/DNI 医嘱，因此需要 RRT。

byChoice.en: The RRT operates under time pressure and will default to the charted code status without proactive communication.
byChoice.zh: RRT 在时间压力下运作，如果没有主动沟通，将默认采用病历上的抢救状态。

byChoice.en: The patient is actively refusing intubation; preparing sedation for the procedure directly violates his autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 患者正在主动拒绝插管；为该程序准备镇静剂直接侵犯了他的自主权。

byChoice.en: This ensures the patient's voice reaches the decision-makers during a time-critical emergency.
byChoice.zh: 这确保了在争分夺秒的紧急情况下，患者的意愿能够传达给决策者。

testTakingStrategy.en: Choose the handoff approach that provides a complete picture of both clinical acuity and ethical constraints.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择既能提供临床危重程度又能提供伦理限制全貌的交接方法。

stem.en: At 1130, after the DNAR/DNI order is entered, which actions evaluate the effectiveness of the advocacy process? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在 1130，下达 DNAR/DNI 医嘱后，哪些行动可以评估倡导流程的有效性？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Verifying the DNAR/DNI order is correctly entered in the electronic health record.
options.zh: 核实 DNAR/DNI 医嘱已正确输入电子健康病历中。

options.en: Ensuring the code status is visually confirmed per policy (e.g., wristband, door sign).
options.zh: 确保按照政策通过视觉确认抢救状态（例如腕带、门标）。

options.en: Notifying the healthcare proxy of the clinical deterioration and advance directive.
options.zh: 将临床恶化情况和预立医疗指示通知医疗代理人。

options.en: Filing an incident report regarding the system vulnerability caused by the delayed provider response.
options.zh: 针对因医生延迟回复而引起的系统漏洞提交事件报告。

options.en: Writing a single retrospective note at the end of the shift summarizing the events.
options.zh: 在交班结束时写一份单一的回顾性记录总结事件。

correct.en: Evaluating the advocacy process involves ensuring the order is properly implemented in all systems (EHR, wristbands), the family/proxy is informed, and recognizing system failures (like delayed provider response) for quality improvement.
correct.zh: 评估倡导流程包括确保在所有系统（EHR、腕带）中正确执行了医嘱，通知了家属/代理人，并识别出系统故障（如有权限的医嘱开立者延迟回复）以进行质量改进。

byChoice.en: Visual identifiers are essential fail-safes during emergencies.
byChoice.zh: 视觉标识是紧急情况下的基本失效保护机制。

byChoice.en: Reporting system-level gaps is vital for institutional quality improvement and future patient safety.
byChoice.zh: 报告系统级漏洞对于机构质量改进和未来的患者安全至关重要。

byChoice.en: Crucial to ensure any responding team recognizes the new code status.
byChoice.zh: 这对于确保任何响应小组都能识别新的抢救状态至关重要。

byChoice.en: The proxy must be aware of the patient's condition and the updated care plan.
byChoice.zh: 代理人必须了解患者的病情及更新的护理计划。

byChoice.en: Documentation must be contemporaneous (done in real-time), not retrospective, to serve its clinical, legal, and ethical functions.
byChoice.zh: 文件记录必须是同期的（实时完成），而不是回顾性的，以发挥其临床、法律和伦理功能。

testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择那些体现了在安全、沟通和系统改进方面彻底闭环的选择。

evidenceCatalog.text: Read the case study and answer the questions that follow.

Advance directive clarification and code status escalation in metastatic lung cancer with acute respiratory decline.
伴有急性呼吸衰退的转移性肺癌中的预立医疗指示澄清和抢救状态升级。

Mr. Harold Jeffries is a 55-year-old man admitted five days ago to a medical-surgical unit with progressive dyspnea and right-sided pleural effusion secondary to metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (stage IV). He is receiving palliative carboplatin-based chemotherapy. Current orders include supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula titrated to maintain SpO₂ > 92%. The attending is a pulmonologist currently in the OR; the covering provider is a hospitalist. The medical record contains no advance directive, POLST, or healthcare power of attorney. The code status is 'Full Code' (default). His daughter Keisha is the emergency contact. At 0700, he states unprompted: 'I've been thinking about this all night. I don't want to be kept alive by machines. If something happens, I don't want them to put a tube down my throat... I just want to be comfortable.'

Harold Jeffries 先生是一位 55 岁的男性，五天前因转移性非小细胞肺癌（IV期）继发的进行性呼吸困难和右侧胸腔积液收治于内外科病房。他正在接受以卡铂为基础的姑息性化疗。目前的医嘱包括通过鼻导管吸氧以维持 SpO₂ > 92%。主治医生是目前在手术室的呼吸科医生；代班医生是住院医师。病历中没有预立医疗指示、维持生命治疗医生医嘱（POLST）或医疗委托书。抢救状态为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”（默认）。他的女儿 Keisha 是紧急联系人。在 0700，他自发地说道：“我整晚都在想这件事。我不想靠机器维持生命。如果发生什么事，我不想他们把管子插进我喉咙里……我只想舒舒服服的。”

stem.zh: 阅读患者病历并回答案例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: postoperative opioid-induced respiratory depression
title.zh: 进展性案例：术后阿片类药物相关呼吸抑制

summary.en: A postoperative client with obstructive sleep apnea becomes difficult to arouse after repeated IV morphine doses. The nurse must recognize opioid-related respiratory compromise, intervene at the bedside, escalate appropriately, anticipate titrated naloxone, and monitor for recurrent sedation.
summary.zh: 一名有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停病史的术后患者在多次接受静脉吗啡后变得难以唤醒。护士需要识别阿片类药物相关的呼吸受损，立即采取床旁干预，适当升级处理，预期按规程小剂量滴定纳洛酮，并监测再次镇静。

content.en:
58-year-old man, 14 hours after open right hemicolectomy for a cecal mass. History: obstructive sleep apnea (uses CPAP at home and brought machine to hospital), obesity (BMI 38), hypertension controlled with hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily, GERD treated with pantoprazole 40 mg daily. No known drug allergies.

Postoperative orders: morphine sulfate 4 mg IV every 3 hours PRN moderate-to-severe pain; ondansetron 4 mg IV every 6 hours PRN nausea; lactated Ringer's at 125 mL/hr; sequential compression devices; incentive spirometry every 2 hours while awake; continuous pulse oximetry. CPAP machine is at bedside but has not been applied since surgery because the client has mostly been upright and awake.

Morphine doses received: 0200, 0500, and 0745. Current time: 0830.
content.zh:
58岁男性，因盲肠肿块行开放性右半结肠切除术后14小时。病史：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（在家使用CPAP，已将机器带到医院）、肥胖（BMI 38）、高血压（每日氢氯噻嗪25 mg控制良好）、胃食管反流病（每日泮托拉唑40 mg）。无已知药物过敏。

术后医嘱：硫酸吗啡4 mg静脉注射，每3小时一次按需用于中重度疼痛；昂丹司琼4 mg静脉注射，每6小时一次按需用于恶心；乳酸林格液125 mL/小时；双侧序贯加压装置；清醒时每2小时使用激励性肺量计；连续脉搏血氧监测。CPAP机器在床旁，但术后尚未使用，因为患者大多保持坐起且清醒。

已接受吗啡时间：0200、0500、0745。当前时间：0830。

content.en:
0715 handoff: awake, conversational, oriented x4. Pain 6/10 at rest; reports morphine "takes the edge off but doesn't last." Using incentive spirometry independently.

Vital signs: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 82/min, BP 138/84 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO2 95% on room air. Pupils 4 mm bilaterally, equal and reactive. Pasero Opioid-Induced Sedation Scale (POSS): 1, awake and alert. Abdominal dressing dry and intact; Jackson-Pratt drain with 40 mL serosanguineous drainage. Bowel sounds absent. Foley catheter: 280 mL clear yellow urine over previous 4 hours. Sequential compression devices in place; pedal pulses palpable.

0600 labs: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL; hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL (preoperative 13.8 g/dL); hematocrit 34.2%; platelets 210 ×10³/µL; sodium 139 mEq/L; potassium 3.9 mEq/L; chloride 101 mEq/L; CO2 26 mEq/L; BUN 18 mg/dL; creatinine 1.0 mg/dL; glucose 168 mg/dL; calcium 8.6 mg/dL. Coagulation studies within expected limits.
content.zh:
0715交接班：清醒、能交谈，定向力（人、地点、时间、情境）均正常。静息疼痛6/10；表示吗啡“能缓解一些，但维持不了多久”。可独立使用激励性肺量计。

生命体征：体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率82次/分，血压138/84 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 95%。双侧瞳孔4 mm，等大等圆，对光反应存在。Pasero阿片类药物诱导镇静量表（POSS）：1分，清醒警觉。腹部敷料干燥完整；Jackson-Pratt引流管有40 mL血清血性引流液。肠鸣音消失。Foley导尿管：过去4小时清亮黄色尿液280 mL。序贯加压装置已使用；足背动脉搏动可触及。

0600实验室：白细胞11.2 ×10³/µL；血红蛋白11.4 g/dL（术前13.8 g/dL）；红细胞压积34.2%；血小板210 ×10³/µL；钠139 mEq/L；钾3.9 mEq/L；氯101 mEq/L；CO2 26 mEq/L；BUN 18 mg/dL；肌酐1.0 mg/dL；葡萄糖168 mg/dL；钙8.6 mg/dL。凝血检查在预期范围内。

title.en: 0830 update: 45 minutes after the 0745 morphine dose

content.en:
The nurse enters for a scheduled assessment and finds the client slumped to one side with eyes closed. He does not respond to his name at normal volume. With loud verbal stimulation and firm tactile stimulation, he briefly opens his eyes, mumbles "I'm fine," and falls back asleep within seconds.

Vital signs: HR 68/min, BP 118/70 mm Hg, RR 8/min and shallow, SpO2 89% on room air. Pupils 2 mm bilaterally, constricted but reactive. POSS: 3, frequently drowsy and difficult to arouse. Pulse oximetry alarm is sounding. Lactated Ringer's is infusing. Next PRN morphine dose is not due until 1045. Abdominal dressing remains dry. Jackson-Pratt output has not changed appreciably. Foley output over the past hour is 20 mL.
content.zh:
护士按计划进入病房评估，发现患者斜靠在床上一侧，双眼闭合。护士用正常音量呼唤姓名时无反应。大声语言刺激和较强触觉刺激后，患者短暂睁眼，含糊地说“我没事”，随后数秒内再次入睡。

生命体征：心率68次/分，血压118/70 mm Hg，呼吸8次/分且浅，室内空气SpO2 89%。双侧瞳孔2 mm，缩小但对光反应存在。POSS：3分，经常嗜睡且难以唤醒。脉搏血氧报警正在响。乳酸林格液正在输注。下一次按需吗啡最早到1045才可给。腹部敷料仍干燥。Jackson-Pratt引流量无明显变化。过去1小时Foley尿量20 mL。

title.en: Respiratory status after stimulation, positioning, and oxygen
title.zh: 刺激、体位调整和给氧后的呼吸状态

content.en:
The nurse has elevated the head of bed to 30 degrees, applied oxygen by nasal cannula at 2 L/min, and continued verbal and tactile stimulation while staying with the client. The client remains minimally responsive, opens eyes only to repeated loud commands, and does not follow instructions to take a deep breath.

Vital signs: HR 62/min, BP 108/66 mm Hg, RR 7/min, SpO2 91% on 2 L/min nasal cannula. POSS remains 3. Respiratory effort is labored with audible snoring respirations and intermittent 6- to 8-second apneic pauses. No additional opioids have been given. The rapid response team has been activated, and the on-call provider has been notified. Naloxone 0.4 mg/mL is available on the unit.
content.zh:
护士已将床头抬高至30度，经鼻导管给予氧气2 L/分，并在床旁持续进行语言和触觉刺激。患者仍反应极少，仅在反复大声指令下睁眼，不能按指令深呼吸。

生命体征：心率62次/分，血压108/66 mm Hg，呼吸7次/分，经鼻导管2 L/分吸氧时SpO2 91%。POSS仍为3分。呼吸费力，可听到鼾样呼吸，并间歇出现6至8秒呼吸暂停。未再给予其他阿片类药物。快速反应团队已启动，值班医务人员已通知。病区可取得纳洛酮0.4 mg/mL。

title.en: 0855 update: after titrated naloxone and rapid response intervention
title.zh: 0855更新：小剂量滴定纳洛酮和快速反应干预后

content.en:
Rapid response team arrived at 0842. Naloxone 0.04 mg IV was administered at 0843 per protocol/order, with a second 0.04 mg IV dose at 0846 for partial response. By 0850, the client opens eyes spontaneously, follows commands, and takes deeper breaths when prompted.

0855 vital signs: HR 78/min, BP 126/78 mm Hg, RR 14/min, SpO2 94% on 2 L/min nasal cannula. Pupils 3 mm bilaterally. POSS: 2, slightly drowsy and easy to arouse. The client reports incisional pain 7/10 and asks, "Can I get something for this pain?" The morphine order has been discontinued. The surgical team is considering multimodal analgesia alternatives. The team notes that naloxone may wear off before the previously administered morphine effect is fully resolved.
content.zh:

Unfolding case: postoperative opioid-induced respiratory depression
进展性案例：术后阿片类药物相关呼吸抑制

A postoperative client with obstructive sleep apnea becomes difficult to arouse after repeated IV morphine doses. The nurse must recognize opioid-related respiratory compromise, intervene at the bedside, escalate appropriately, anticipate titrated naloxone, and monitor for recurrent sedation.
一名有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停病史的术后患者在多次接受静脉吗啡后变得难以唤醒。护士需要识别阿片类药物相关的呼吸受损，立即采取床旁干预，适当升级处理，预期按规程小剂量滴定纳洛酮，并监测再次镇静。

58-year-old man, 14 hours after open right hemicolectomy for a cecal mass. History: obstructive sleep apnea (uses CPAP at home and brought machine to hospital), obesity (BMI 38), hypertension controlled with hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily, GERD treated with pantoprazole 40 mg daily. No known drug allergies.

Postoperative orders: morphine sulfate 4 mg IV every 3 hours PRN moderate-to-severe pain; ondansetron 4 mg IV every 6 hours PRN nausea; lactated Ringer's at 125 mL/hr; sequential compression devices; incentive spirometry every 2 hours while awake; continuous pulse oximetry. CPAP machine is at bedside but has not been applied since surgery because the client has mostly been upright and awake.

Morphine doses received: 0200, 0500, and 0745. Current time: 0830.

58岁男性，因盲肠肿块行开放性右半结肠切除术后14小时。病史：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（在家使用CPAP，已将机器带到医院）、肥胖（BMI 38）、高血压（每日氢氯噻嗪25 mg控制良好）、胃食管反流病（每日泮托拉唑40 mg）。无已知药物过敏。

术后医嘱：硫酸吗啡4 mg静脉注射，每3小时一次按需用于中重度疼痛；昂丹司琼4 mg静脉注射，每6小时一次按需用于恶心；乳酸林格液125 mL/小时；双侧序贯加压装置；清醒时每2小时使用激励性肺量计；连续脉搏血氧监测。CPAP机器在床旁，但术后尚未使用，因为患者大多保持坐起且清醒。

已接受吗啡时间：0200、0500、0745。当前时间：0830。

0715 handoff: awake, conversational, oriented x4. Pain 6/10 at rest; reports morphine "takes the edge off but doesn't last." Using incentive spirometry independently.

Vital signs: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 82/min, BP 138/84 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO2 95% on room air. Pupils 4 mm bilaterally, equal and reactive. Pasero Opioid-Induced Sedation Scale (POSS): 1, awake and alert. Abdominal dressing dry and intact; Jackson-Pratt drain with 40 mL serosanguineous drainage. Bowel sounds absent. Foley catheter: 280 mL clear yellow urine over previous 4 hours. Sequential compression devices in place; pedal pulses palpable.

0600 labs: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL; hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL (preoperative 13.8 g/dL); hematocrit 34.2%; platelets 210 ×10³/µL; sodium 139 mEq/L; potassium 3.9 mEq/L; chloride 101 mEq/L; CO2 26 mEq/L; BUN 18 mg/dL; creatinine 1.0 mg/dL; glucose 168 mg/dL; calcium 8.6 mg/dL. Coagulation studies within expected limits.

0715交接班：清醒、能交谈，定向力（人、地点、时间、情境）均正常。静息疼痛6/10；表示吗啡“能缓解一些，但维持不了多久”。可独立使用激励性肺量计。

生命体征：体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率82次/分，血压138/84 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 95%。双侧瞳孔4 mm，等大等圆，对光反应存在。Pasero阿片类药物诱导镇静量表（POSS）：1分，清醒警觉。腹部敷料干燥完整；Jackson-Pratt引流管有40 mL血清血性引流液。肠鸣音消失。Foley导尿管：过去4小时清亮黄色尿液280 mL。序贯加压装置已使用；足背动脉搏动可触及。

summary.en: Mrs. Elaine Torrance, a 58-year-old postoperative orthopedic client, is stable after open reduction and internal fixation of a left tibial plateau fracture. During the day shift, RN Jordan must recognize, contain, report, and evaluate several privacy risks and unauthorized PHI exposures.
summary.zh: Elaine Torrance女士，58岁，因左胫骨平台骨折行切开复位内固定术后，目前病情稳定。白班期间，Jordan护士必须识别、控制、上报并评价多起隐私风险和未经授权的PHI暴露。

title.en: Baseline client profile and facility policy
title.zh: 基线患者资料与机构政策

content.en: Mrs. Torrance is postoperative day 1 after ORIF of a left tibial plateau fracture. She is alert, oriented, and participates in care. Emergency contact/authorized contact listed in the chart: adult daughter Megan Torrance only. The facility policy requires the nurse who discovers or witnesses a potential privacy breach to immediately mitigate exposure, notify the charge nurse, complete an electronic incident report, and ensure same-shift notification to the unit manager and Privacy Officer. Incident reports are quality-improvement documents and must not be referenced in the medical record.
content.zh: Torrance女士左胫骨平台骨折ORIF术后第1天。她清醒、定向力正常，并参与自己的照护。病历中列出的紧急/授权联系人仅为成年女儿Megan Torrance。机构政策要求发现或目击潜在隐私泄露的护士立即控制暴露、通知 charge nurse、完成电子事件报告，并确保同班次通知单元经理和隐私官。事件报告属于质量改进文件，不得在病历中提及。

content.en: 0715 vital signs: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 78/min, BP 134/82 mm Hg, RR 14/min, SpO2 97% on room air. Dressing is clean, dry, and intact; distal neurovascular status is intact. Pain is 4/10. 0600 labs: Hgb 11.4 g/dL, creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 52 mL/min, glucose 168 mg/dL. Mrs. Torrance says she is worried about how long she will be off work and whether her employer will learn details of her medical condition.
content.zh: 0715生命体征：T 99 °F (37.2 °C)，HR 78次/分，BP 134/82 mm Hg，RR 14次/分，室内空气SpO2 97%。敷料清洁、干燥、完整；远端神经血管状态完整。疼痛4/10。0600化验：Hgb 11.4 g/dL，肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 52 mL/min，血糖168 mg/dL。Torrance女士表示担心自己要停工多久，以及雇主是否会知道她病情细节。

title.zh: 阶段1：0730-1030，披露事件陆续发生

content.en: 0745: A caller says he is Robert Torrance, the client's husband, and asks for lab results and discharge timing. Robert is not listed as an authorized contact. 0830: RN Casey, assigned to another pod and with no care role, is seen scrolling through Mrs. Torrance's operative report and MAR because of personal interest in orthopedic notes. 0945: The employer faxes the unit requesting admission records, operative report, and anticipated return-to-work date for workers' compensation processing; no signed patient authorization is attached. 1015: A nursing student uses a personal smartphone to photograph the wound for a class presentation; the hospital ID wristband is visible, and there is no written consent. 1025: Two nurses give report in the hallway and discuss another patient's HIV status and medication regimen by name while a visitor can hear. Mrs. Torrance remains clinically stable at 1030.
content.zh: 0745：一名来电者自称是患者丈夫Robert Torrance，要求得知化验结果和出院时间；Robert未列为授权联系人。0830：Casey护士被分配在另一护理区且无照护职责，却因个人对骨科记录感兴趣而浏览Torrance女士的手术记录和MAR。0945：雇主将传真发到护理单元，要求入院记录、手术报告和预计返工日期以处理工伤赔偿；未附患者签署的授权书。1015：一名护生用个人智能手机拍摄伤口，准备课堂汇报；医院身份腕带可见，且无书面同意。1025：两名护士在走廊交班，按姓名讨论另一名患者的HIV状态和用药，旁边访客能够听到。1030时Torrance女士临床状况仍稳定。

content.en: RN Jordan mitigates each exposure in real time while formal follow-up continues. Mrs. Torrance states she and Robert are legally separated and she does not want him to receive any information; only Megan remains authorized. RN Casey is dismissive and says she did not share the information. The charge nurse confirms the access is unauthorized and directs incident reporting and Privacy Officer notification. RN Jordan does not release employer records, secures the fax, and contacts HIM, which states that release requires a signed authorization or valid legal basis and must be processed through HIM. The student confirms the photo was not shared; RN Jordan has the student delete it immediately, including recently deleted storage, with the instructor present, and reports the event for Privacy Officer review of possible cloud syncing. RN Jordan moves the hallway report to a private area. By 1200, incident reporting is complete and is not documented in the medical record.
content.zh: Jordan护士对每次暴露实时采取控制措施，同时正式跟进持续进行。Torrance女士表示她与Robert已合法分居，不希望他获得任何信息；仍只授权Megan。Casey护士不以为然，称自己没有分享信息。charge nurse确认该访问未经授权，并要求完成事件报告和通知隐私官。Jordan护士未向雇主释放资料，妥善保管传真并联系HIM；HIM说明释放资料需要患者签署授权或有效法律依据，且必须由HIM处理。护生确认照片未分享；Jordan护士在指导老师在场时让护生立即删除照片，包括最近删除存储，并上报由隐私官评估可能的云端同步。Jordan护士将走廊交班移至私密区域。到1200，事件报告已完成，且未记录在病历中。

title.zh: 阶段3：1400-1900，后续跟进与系统防护
隐私官审查与防护措施

content.en: At 1430, the Privacy Officer states RN Casey's access will be investigated through the formal breach-determination process using the EHR audit trail. The student's photo is also reviewed as a potential breach. At 1500, HIM confirms no employer records will be released without a signed authorization or valid legal basis. At 1530, Mrs. Torrance asks about a concern with her chart; RN Jordan acknowledges the facility is aware of a concern and the Privacy Officer is handling it, without naming staff or disclosing investigation details. At 1700, safeguards under review include fax-machine signage to redirect records requests to HIM, instructor reinforcement of the no-identifiable-photo policy, an in-service on minimum-necessary access and audit trails, and staff review of private spaces for report. By 1900, the client remains clinically stable.
content.zh: 1430，隐私官表示将使用电子病历审计追踪，通过正式隐私事件判定流程调查Casey护士的访问。护生照片也作为潜在隐私事件审查。1500，HIM确认没有患者签署授权或有效法律依据，不会向雇主释放资料。1530，Torrance女士询问自己的病历是否出了问题；Jordan护士承认机构已知晓相关关注点并由隐私官处理，但不透露工作人员姓名或调查细节。1700，正在审查的防护措施包括在传真机旁张贴标识，提醒将病历请求转至HIM；指导老师强化禁止可识别患者照片的政策；开展最低必要访问和审计追踪的短讲；并复习在私密空间交班。到1900，患者临床状况仍稳定。

options.en: Secure the employer fax and redirect the request to HIM rather than releasing records from the nursing unit.
options.zh: 妥善保管雇主传真并将请求转给HIM，不从护理单元释放病历。

options.en: Have the student delete the identifiable photo, including recently deleted storage, in the presence of RN Jordan and the instructor; report for Privacy Officer follow-up.
options.zh: 让护生在Jordan护士和指导老师在场时删除可识别照片，包括最近删除文件夹；并上报由隐私官跟进。

options.en: Document in Mrs. Torrance's medical record that incident reports were filed for the privacy breaches.
options.zh: 在Torrance女士病历中记录已为隐私泄露提交事件报告。

options.en: Interrupt the hallway report and move the nurses to a private space to finish patient-specific communication.
options.zh: 打断走廊交班，让护士转到私密空间完成涉及患者的信息沟通。

options.en: Release no information to Robert; ask Mrs. Torrance whether she authorizes him and document her restriction if she declines.
options.zh: 不向Robert透露信息；询问Torrance女士是否授权他接收信息，如拒绝则记录她的限制。

options.en: Ask RN Casey to exit the chart, notify the charge nurse, complete the incident report, and keep the report out of the medical record.
options.zh: 要求Casey护士退出病历，通知 charge nurse，完成事件报告，并且不要把事件报告写入病历。

correct.en: The correct response combines immediate mitigation, proper reporting, and prevention of further disclosure for each event. The nurse should not reference the incident report in the patient's medical record because the incident report is a quality-improvement/risk-management document kept separate from clinical documentation.
correct.zh: 正确处理包括对每个事件立即控制暴露、按正确链条上报，并防止进一步披露。护士不能在患者病历中提及事件报告，因为事件报告属于质量改进/风险管理文件，应与临床病历分开保存。

byChoice.en: Immediate deletion limits exposure, but reporting is still needed because cloud syncing or other retention must be investigated.
byChoice.zh: 立即删除可限制暴露，但仍需上报，因为是否云端同步或保留还需调查。

byChoice.en: The patient controls who receives information; she later states Robert should not receive information.
byChoice.zh: 患者有权决定谁可接收信息；她之后明确表示Robert不能接收信息。

byChoice.en: Records requests belong with HIM, which can verify authorization or legal authority and apply minimum-necessary limits.
byChoice.zh: 病历请求应由HIM处理，由其核实授权或法律依据并执行最低必要范围。

byChoice.en: This follows the facility sequence: mitigate active access, notify the charge nurse, then complete formal reporting outside the clinical chart.
byChoice.zh: 这符合机构流程：先控制正在发生的访问，通知 charge nurse，再在临床病历之外完成正式报告。

byChoice.en: Moving the report to a private area stops an ongoing verbal disclosure risk.
byChoice.zh: 将交班移至私密区域可以停止正在发生的口头披露风险。

byChoice.en: The medical record should contain clinical care documentation, not references to incident reports or risk-management documents.
byChoice.zh: 病历应记录临床照护内容，而不是事件报告或风险管理文件。

testTakingStrategy.en: For privacy events, choose actions that contain the exposure and route the issue to the correct reporting channel. Reject actions that put risk-management documents in the chart.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理隐私事件时，选择能控制暴露并把问题送入正确上报渠道的措施。排除把风险管理文件写入病历的做法。

stem.en: Review the client record for a client receiving vancomycin for MRSA bacteremia and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查看一名因 MRSA 菌血症接受万古霉素治疗的患者记录，并回答案例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: vancomycin infusion reaction and nephrotoxicity
title.zh: 展开式案例：万古霉素输注反应与肾毒性

summary.en: A 67-year-old man with MRSA bacteremia, stage 3b chronic kidney disease, diabetes, hypertension treated with lisinopril and carvedilol, and baseline bilateral sensorineural hearing loss begins pharmacy-guided vancomycin therapy.
summary.zh: 一名 67 岁男性因 MRSA 菌血症开始由药师指导的万古霉素治疗；既往有 3b 期慢性肾病、糖尿病、使用赖诺普利和卡维地洛治疗的高血压，以及基线双侧感音神经性听力下降。

content.en:
Age: 67 years. Admitted from the emergency department with two blood-culture sets showing gram-positive cocci in clusters with preliminary MRSA identification. Suspected source: infected left forearm arteriovenous fistula with erythema, warmth, induration, tenderness, and purulent drainage.
History: stage 3b chronic kidney disease; baseline creatinine 1.6 mg/dL; estimated baseline creatinine clearance 44 mL/min; type 2 diabetes; hypertension; obesity; bilateral sensorineural hearing loss managed with hearing aids. No documented drug allergies.
Orders: vancomycin 2,000 mg IV loading dose over at least 2 hours, then 1,250 mg IV every 12 hours; vancomycin trough before the fourth maintenance dose; normal saline 75 mL/hr; strict intake and output; daily basic metabolic panel; repeat blood cultures in 48 hours; transthoracic echocardiogram; vascular surgery consult. Home medications continued, including lisinopril 10 mg daily and carvedilol 12.5 mg twice daily. No premedication is ordered before the first vancomycin dose.
content.zh:
年龄：67 岁。患者从急诊收入院，两组血培养显示成簇革兰阳性球菌，初步鉴定为 MRSA。疑似来源：左前臂动静脉瘘感染，局部发红、发热、硬结、压痛，并有脓性引流。
病史：3b 期慢性肾病；基线肌酐 1.6 mg/dL；估算基线肌酐清除率 44 mL/min；2 型糖尿病；高血压；肥胖；双侧感音神经性听力下降，使用助听器。无已记录药物过敏。
医嘱：万古霉素 2,000 mg IV 负荷剂量，至少输注 2 小时；随后 1,250 mg IV 每 12 小时一次；第 4 次维持剂量前抽万古霉素谷浓度；0.9% 氯化钠 75 mL/小时；严格记录出入量；每日基础代谢面板；48 小时后复查血培养；经胸超声心动图；血管外科会诊。继续家庭用药，包括赖诺普利 10 mg 每日一次和卡维地洛 12.5 mg 每日两次。首次万古霉素前未开具预处理用药。

title.en: 1400 baseline assessment and ED laboratory results
title.zh: 1400 基线评估与急诊实验室结果

content.en:
Vital signs: temperature 101.5 °F (38.6 °C), heart rate 96/min regular, blood pressure 142/84 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
Assessment: alert and oriented; no rash, flushing, urticaria, or angioedema; lungs clear; chronic 1+ bilateral lower-extremity edema; right antecubital 18-gauge peripheral IV flushes easily. Hearing is functional with hearing aids in place.
Labs drawn at 1200: WBC 14.8 ×10³/µL with 82% neutrophils and 9% bands; hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL; platelets 228 ×10³/µL; sodium 138 mEq/L; potassium 4.6 mEq/L; bicarbonate 22 mEq/L; BUN 32 mg/dL; creatinine 1.8 mg/dL; eGFR 38 mL/min; glucose 198 mg/dL; lactate 2.2 mmol/L; albumin 2.8 g/dL. Urinalysis: trace protein, no casts, no bacteria.
content.zh:
生命体征：体温 101.5 °F (38.6 °C)，心率 96 次/分且规则，血压 142/84 mm Hg，呼吸 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
评估：神志清楚并定向力完整；无皮疹、潮红、荨麻疹或血管性水肿；双肺清；双下肢慢性 1+ 水肿；右肘前 18G 外周静脉针冲管通畅。佩戴助听器时听力可满足交流。
1200 抽血结果：WBC 14.8 ×10³/µL，中性粒细胞 82%，杆状核 9%；血红蛋白 11.2 g/dL；血小板 228 ×10³/µL；钠 138 mEq/L；钾 4.6 mEq/L；碳酸氢根 22 mEq/L；BUN 32 mg/dL；肌酐 1.8 mg/dL；eGFR 38 mL/min；血糖 198 mg/dL；乳酸 2.2 mmol/L；白蛋白 2.8 g/dL。尿液分析：微量蛋白，无管型，无细菌。

title.zh: 万古霉素开始后 15 分钟

content.en:
The 2,000 mg loading dose was started at 1430 by infusion pump to run over 120 minutes. At 1445, the client reports sudden intense itching of the face, neck, and upper chest and says his skin feels like it is burning. He denies shortness of breath, throat tightness, tongue swelling, or difficulty swallowing.
Assessment: face, neck, and upper trunk are diffusely flushed with a clear lower boundary near the nipple line; lower trunk and extremities are unaffected. Scattered raised, pruritic, blanchable wheals are present across the anterior chest. No stridor, wheezing, lip or tongue angioedema, or urticaria below the waist. He is anxious but alert and breathing comfortably.
Vital signs: heart rate 118/min, blood pressure 108/62 mm Hg, respiratory rate 20/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
content.zh:
2,000 mg 负荷剂量于 1430 用输液泵开始，计划 120 分钟输完。1445，患者诉面部、颈部和上胸部突然剧烈瘙痒，并说皮肤像在烧。他否认气短、喉咙发紧、舌肿或吞咽困难。
评估：面部、颈部和上半身弥漫性潮红，下界清楚，约在乳头线附近；下半身和四肢未受影响。前胸可见散在隆起、瘙痒、按压可褪色的风团。无喘鸣、哮鸣、唇舌血管性水肿或腰以下荨麻疹。患者焦虑但清醒，呼吸舒适。
生命体征：心率 118 次/分，血压 108/62 mm Hg，呼吸 20 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。

title.zh: 阶段 1 干预后的反应

content.en: The infusion is stopped, the IV is kept patent with normal saline, the client is positioned supine with legs slightly elevated, vital signs are repeated, and the provider is notified. Diphenhydramine 25 mg IV and acetaminophen 650 mg PO are administered as ordered. Symptoms improve after 30 minutes. The provider orders vancomycin to restart at half the original rate. The remaining dose completes without recurrent symptoms. The event is documented as an infusion-related adverse drug reaction rather than a drug allergy.
content.zh: 停止输注，用生理盐水保持静脉通路通畅，使患者仰卧并轻度抬高双腿，复测生命体征，并通知医嘱者。按医嘱给予苯海拉明 25 mg IV 和对乙酰氨基酚 650 mg PO。30 分钟后症状改善。医嘱者要求以原速度一半重新开始万古霉素。剩余剂量完成后未再出现症状。该事件记录为输注相关不良药物反应，而不是药物过敏。

title.en: Stage 2: hospital day 3 trough and monitoring
title.zh: 阶段 2：住院第 3 天谷浓度与监测

content.en:
The client has received three maintenance doses of vancomycin 1,250 mg IV every 12 hours without recurrent flushing; each dose was premedicated with diphenhydramine and infused over at least 2 hours. The trough drawn at 0730 before the fourth maintenance dose returns at 0830: 22.4 mcg/mL. Institutional trough-surrogate protocol flags this as supratherapeutic.
Pharmacist recommendation being communicated to the infectious disease provider: reduce vancomycin to 1,000 mg IV every 12 hours, recheck the trough before the third dose on the new regimen, and increase monitoring for nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity.
Morning labs: WBC 12.2 ×10³/µL, creatinine 1.7 mg/dL, BUN 28 mg/dL, potassium 4.4 mEq/L, lactate 1.4 mmol/L, glucose 164 mg/dL. Urine output previous 24 hours: 1,440 mL.
content.zh:
患者已接受三次万古霉素维持剂量 1,250 mg IV 每 12 小时一次，未再出现潮红；每次均先给予苯海拉明预处理，并至少输注 2 小时。0730 于第 4 次维持剂量前抽取的谷浓度在 0830 返回：22.4 mcg/mL。机构谷浓度替代方案将其标记为超治疗范围。
药师正向感染科医嘱者传达建议：将万古霉素减量为 1,000 mg IV 每 12 小时一次，在新方案第 3 次剂量前复查谷浓度，并加强肾毒性和耳毒性监测。
晨间化验：WBC 12.2 ×10³/µL，肌酐 1.7 mg/dL，BUN 28 mg/dL，钾 4.4 mEq/L，乳酸 1.4 mmol/L，血糖 164 mg/dL。过去 24 小时尿量：1,440 mL。

title.en: Stage 3: hospital day 4 kidney injury and tinnitus
title.zh: 阶段 3：住院第 4 天肾损伤与耳鸣

content.en:
The client has received vancomycin 1,000 mg IV every 12 hours since the dose adjustment. Current trough: 18.6 mcg/mL, within the institutional surrogate target range.
Vital signs: temperature 99.3 °F (37.4 °C), heart rate 82/min, blood pressure 148/88 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
Morning labs: creatinine 2.4 mg/dL, BUN 44 mg/dL, potassium 5.1 mEq/L, bicarbonate 19 mEq/L, eGFR 26 mL/min. Overnight urine output: 180 mL in 12 hours. Urine is dark amber and concentrated.
The client reports new persistent bilateral ringing in the ears that began overnight. Repeat blood cultures from day 2 show no growth at 48 hours; echocardiogram shows no vegetations; AV fistula erythema and drainage are improving. Lower-extremity edema is now 2+ bilaterally.
content.zh:
自减量后，患者一直接受万古霉素 1,000 mg IV 每 12 小时一次。当前谷浓度：18.6 mcg/mL，在机构替代目标范围内。
生命体征：体温 99.3 °F (37.4 °C)，心率 82 次/分，血压 148/88 mm Hg，呼吸 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
晨间化验：肌酐 2.4 mg/dL，BUN 44 mg/dL，钾 5.1 mEq/L，碳酸氢根 19 mEq/L，eGFR 26 mL/min。夜间尿量：12 小时 180 mL。尿液呈深琥珀色且浓缩。
患者报告夜间开始出现新的持续性双侧耳鸣。第 2 天复查血培养 48 小时无生长；超声心动图无赘生物；动静脉瘘红斑和引流改善。双下肢水肿现在为 2+。

content.en: The infectious disease provider orders: hold vancomycin; obtain a stat vancomycin level; switch to renally dosed daptomycin 6 mg/kg IV every 48 hours; hold lisinopril; obtain a renal ultrasound; request nephrology consult. The stat vancomycin level later returns at 24.1 mcg/mL.
content.zh: 感染科医嘱者下达医嘱：暂停万古霉素；立即抽取万古霉素水平；改用按肾功能调整剂量的达托霉素 6 mg/kg IV 每 48 小时一次；暂停赖诺普利；做肾脏超声；请肾内科会诊。之后立即抽取的万古霉素水平返回为 24.1 mcg/mL。

stem.en: Stage 1: Fifteen minutes after the vancomycin loading dose begins, the client develops intense itching, flushing limited to the face/neck/upper trunk, chest wheals, tachycardia, and mild hypotension. He has no wheezing, stridor, tongue swelling, throat tightness, or generalized urticaria. Which action should the nurse take first?
stem.zh: 阶段 1：万古霉素负荷剂量开始 15 分钟后，患者出现剧烈瘙痒，潮红局限于面部、颈部和上半身，胸前有风团，心动过速并轻度低血压。无哮鸣、喘鸣、舌肿、喉咙发紧或全身性荨麻疹。护士首先应采取哪项措施？

stem.en: Stage 1: The flushing and itching resolve after the infusion is stopped and diphenhydramine is administered. The provider restarts the remaining dose at a slower rate without recurrence of symptoms. Complete the nursing documentation and handoff statement.
stem.zh: 阶段 1：停止输注并给予苯海拉明后，潮红和瘙痒缓解。医嘱者以较慢速度重新开始剩余剂量，症状未复发。完成护士记录和交接说明。

stem.en: Stage 2: The pharmacist recommends increased ototoxicity monitoring. The client has baseline bilateral hearing loss and uses hearing aids. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段 2：药师建议加强耳毒性监测。患者基线已有双侧听力下降，并使用助听器。哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Stage 3: Classify each finding based on how it should affect the nurse's interpretation of the scheduled 0800 vancomycin dose.
stem.zh: 阶段 3：根据每项发现对护士解读 0800 预定万古霉素剂量安全性的影响进行分类。

stem.en: Stage 3: Vancomycin has been held and the antibiotic plan is being changed because of acute kidney injury and new tinnitus. The nurse reviews the medication administration record and sees that lisinopril 10 mg daily is still active and the morning dose has not been given. Potassium is 5.1 mEq/L. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 阶段 3：因急性肾损伤和新的耳鸣，万古霉素已被暂停，抗生素方案正在更改。护士查看给药记录，发现赖诺普利 10 mg 每日一次仍为有效医嘱，晨间剂量尚未给予。钾为 5.1 mEq/L。护士应怎么做？

stem.en: Stage 2: The vancomycin trough returns at 22.4 mcg/mL 30 minutes before the next scheduled 1,250 mg dose. The pharmacist recommends a dose reduction and is contacting the infectious disease provider. Arrange the nurse's actions in the safest order.
stem.zh: 阶段 2：下一次预定 1,250 mg 剂量前 30 分钟，万古霉素谷浓度返回为 22.4 mcg/mL。药师建议减量，并正在联系感染科医嘱者。请按最安全顺序排列护士的行动。

options.en: Document the trough, held dose, notifications, verified new order, and monitoring plan.
options.zh: 记录谷浓度、暂缓给药、通知情况、已核实的新医嘱以及监测计划。

options.en: Hold the scheduled 1,250 mg vancomycin dose while the order is being clarified.
options.zh: 在澄清医嘱期间，暂缓预定的 1,250 mg 万古霉素剂量。

options.en: Contact the prescriber to confirm the revised dosing order recommended by pharmacy.
options.zh: 联系医嘱者，确认药师建议的修订剂量医嘱。

options.en: Administer the revised dose using the ordered premedication and slower infusion precautions.
options.zh: 按已下达的预处理和较慢输注预防措施，给予修订后的剂量。

options.en: Verify that the new 1,000 mg vancomycin order is active in the medication administration record.
options.zh: 核实新的 1,000 mg 万古霉素医嘱已在给药记录中生效。

correct.en: A supratherapeutic trough in a client with impaired renal clearance makes the current scheduled dose unsafe to administer without clarification. The nurse should hold the dose, obtain the revised provider order, verify it in the MAR, administer only the corrected regimen with the ordered precautions, and document the safety actions and monitoring plan.
correct.zh: 肾清除功能受损的患者出现超治疗范围谷浓度时，若不澄清医嘱，当前预定剂量不安全。护士应暂缓给药，取得医嘱者修订医嘱，在给药记录中核实后，仅按纠正后的方案和已下达预防措施给药，并记录安全行动和监测计划。

byChoice.en: After the corrected order is active, the revised dose may be given with the prior flushing precautions.
byChoice.zh: 纠正后的医嘱生效后，可结合既往潮红反应的预防措施给予修订剂量。

byChoice.en: Holding first prevents avoidable accumulation while the unsafe current order is being revised.
byChoice.zh: 首先暂缓给药可在不安全的现有医嘱被修订期间避免药物继续蓄积。

byChoice.en: Verification in the MAR prevents administering from an old or unentered order.
byChoice.zh: 在给药记录中核实可防止按旧医嘱或未录入医嘱给药。

byChoice.en: The nurse must obtain prescriber clarification rather than independently changing the dose.
byChoice.zh: 护士必须取得医嘱者澄清，而不是自行改变剂量。

byChoice.en: Documentation follows the clinical actions and creates a clear record of the abnormal level, hold, communication, and follow-up monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在临床行动之后进行，清楚说明异常浓度、暂缓给药、沟通和后续监测。

testTakingStrategy.en: For ordered-response medication safety items, protect the client first, then clarify the order, verify the corrected order, administer only when safe, and document after action is taken.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 药物安全排序题中，先保护患者，再澄清医嘱，核实纠正后的医嘱，确认安全后才给药，最后记录已采取的行动。

1200 抽血结果：WBC 14.8 ×10³/µL，中性粒细胞 82%，杆状核 9%；血红蛋白 11.2 g/dL；血小板 228 ×10³/µL；钠 138 mEq/L；钾 4.6 mEq/L；碳酸氢根 22 mEq/L；BUN 32 mg/dL；肌酐 1.8 mg/dL；eGFR 38 mL/min；血糖 198 mg/dL；乳酸 2.2 mmol/L；白蛋白 2.8 g/dL。尿液分析：微量蛋白，无管型，无细菌。
1400 baseline assessment and ED laboratory results
1400 基线评估与急诊实验室结果

The 2,000 mg loading dose was started at 1430 by infusion pump to run over 120 minutes. At 1445, the client reports sudden intense itching of the face, neck, and upper chest and says his skin feels like it is burning. He denies shortness of breath, throat tightness, tongue swelling, or difficulty swallowing.
Assessment: face, neck, and upper trunk are diffusely flushed with a clear lower boundary near the nipple line; lower trunk and extremities are unaffected. Scattered raised, pruritic, blanchable wheals are present across the anterior chest. No stridor, wheezing, lip or tongue angioedema, or urticaria below the waist. He is anxious but alert and breathing comfortably.
Vital signs: heart rate 118/min, blood pressure 108/62 mm Hg, respiratory rate 20/min, SpO2 96% on room air.

2,000 mg 负荷剂量于 1430 用输液泵开始，计划 120 分钟输完。1445，患者诉面部、颈部和上胸部突然剧烈瘙痒，并说皮肤像在烧。他否认气短、喉咙发紧、舌肿或吞咽困难。
评估：面部、颈部和上半身弥漫性潮红，下界清楚，约在乳头线附近；下半身和四肢未受影响。前胸可见散在隆起、瘙痒、按压可褪色的风团。无喘鸣、哮鸣、唇舌血管性水肿或腰以下荨麻疹。患者焦虑但清醒，呼吸舒适。
生命体征：心率 118 次/分，血压 108/62 mm Hg，呼吸 20 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
万古霉素开始后 15 分钟

The infusion is stopped, the IV is kept patent with normal saline, the client is positioned supine with legs slightly elevated, vital signs are repeated, and the provider is notified. Diphenhydramine 25 mg IV and acetaminophen 650 mg PO are administered as ordered. Symptoms improve after 30 minutes. The provider orders vancomycin to restart at half the original rate. The remaining dose completes without recurrent symptoms. The event is documented as an infusion-related adverse drug reaction rather than a drug allergy.
停止输注，用生理盐水保持静脉通路通畅，使患者仰卧并轻度抬高双腿，复测生命体征，并通知医嘱者。按医嘱给予苯海拉明 25 mg IV 和对乙酰氨基酚 650 mg PO。30 分钟后症状改善。医嘱者要求以原速度一半重新开始万古霉素。剩余剂量完成后未再出现症状。该事件记录为输注相关不良药物反应，而不是药物过敏。
阶段 1 干预后的反应

The client has received three maintenance doses of vancomycin 1,250 mg IV every 12 hours without recurrent flushing; each dose was premedicated with diphenhydramine and infused over at least 2 hours. The trough drawn at 0730 before the fourth maintenance dose returns at 0830: 22.4 mcg/mL. Institutional trough-surrogate protocol flags this as supratherapeutic.
Pharmacist recommendation being communicated to the infectious disease provider: reduce vancomycin to 1,000 mg IV every 12 hours, recheck the trough before the third dose on the new regimen, and increase monitoring for nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity.
Morning labs: WBC 12.2 ×10³/µL, creatinine 1.7 mg/dL, BUN 28 mg/dL, potassium 4.4 mEq/L, lactate 1.4 mmol/L, glucose 164 mg/dL. Urine output previous 24 hours: 1,440 mL.

患者已接受三次万古霉素维持剂量 1,250 mg IV 每 12 小时一次，未再出现潮红；每次均先给予苯海拉明预处理，并至少输注 2 小时。0730 于第 4 次维持剂量前抽取的谷浓度在 0830 返回：22.4 mcg/mL。机构谷浓度替代方案将其标记为超治疗范围。
药师正向感染科医嘱者传达建议：将万古霉素减量为 1,000 mg IV 每 12 小时一次，在新方案第 3 次剂量前复查谷浓度，并加强肾毒性和耳毒性监测。
晨间化验：WBC 12.2 ×10³/µL，肌酐 1.7 mg/dL，BUN 28 mg/dL，钾 4.4 mEq/L，乳酸 1.4 mmol/L，血糖 164 mg/dL。过去 24 小时尿量：1,440 mL。
Stage 2: hospital day 3 trough and monitoring
阶段 2：住院第 3 天谷浓度与监测

The client has received vancomycin 1,000 mg IV every 12 hours since the dose adjustment. Current trough: 18.6 mcg/mL, within the institutional surrogate target range.
Vital signs: temperature 99.3 °F (37.4 °C), heart rate 82/min, blood pressure 148/88 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
Morning labs: creatinine 2.4 mg/dL, BUN 44 mg/dL, potassium 5.1 mEq/L, bicarbonate 19 mEq/L, eGFR 26 mL/min. Overnight urine output: 180 mL in 12 hours. Urine is dark amber and concentrated.
The client reports new persistent bilateral ringing in the ears that began overnight. Repeat blood cultures from day 2 show no growth at 48 hours; echocardiogram shows no vegetations; AV fistula erythema and drainage are improving. Lower-extremity edema is now 2+ bilaterally.

自减量后，患者一直接受万古霉素 1,000 mg IV 每 12 小时一次。当前谷浓度：18.6 mcg/mL，在机构替代目标范围内。
生命体征：体温 99.3 °F (37.4 °C)，心率 82 次/分，血压 148/88 mm Hg，呼吸 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
晨间化验：肌酐 2.4 mg/dL，BUN 44 mg/dL，钾 5.1 mEq/L，碳酸氢根 19 mEq/L，eGFR 26 mL/min。夜间尿量：12 小时 180 mL。尿液呈深琥珀色且浓缩。
患者报告夜间开始出现新的持续性双侧耳鸣。第 2 天复查血培养 48 小时无生长；超声心动图无赘生物；动静脉瘘红斑和引流改善。双下肢水肿现在为 2+。

The infectious disease provider orders: hold vancomycin; obtain a stat vancomycin level; switch to renally dosed daptomycin 6 mg/kg IV every 48 hours; hold lisinopril; obtain a renal ultrasound; request nephrology consult. The stat vancomycin level later returns at 24.1 mcg/mL.
感染科医嘱者下达医嘱：暂停万古霉素；立即抽取万古霉素水平；改用按肾功能调整剂量的达托霉素 6 mg/kg IV 每 48 小时一次；暂停赖诺普利；做肾脏超声；请肾内科会诊。之后立即抽取的万古霉素水平返回为 24.1 mcg/mL。
Stage 3: hospital day 4 kidney injury and tinnitus
阶段 3：住院第 4 天肾损伤与耳鸣

Stage 1: Fifteen minutes after the vancomycin loading dose begins, the client develops intense itching, flushing limited to the face/neck/upper trunk, chest wheals, tachycardia, and mild hypotension. He has no wheezing, stridor, tongue swelling, throat tightness, or generalized urticaria. Which action should the nurse take first?
阶段 1：万古霉素负荷剂量开始 15 分钟后，患者出现剧烈瘙痒，潮红局限于面部、颈部和上半身，胸前有风团，心动过速并轻度低血压。无哮鸣、喘鸣、舌肿、喉咙发紧或全身性荨麻疹。护士首先应采取哪项措施？

Stage 1: The flushing and itching resolve after the infusion is stopped and diphenhydramine is administered. The provider restarts the remaining dose at a slower rate without recurrence of symptoms. Complete the nursing documentation and handoff statement.
阶段 1：停止输注并给予苯海拉明后，潮红和瘙痒缓解。医嘱者以较慢速度重新开始剩余剂量，症状未复发。完成护士记录和交接说明。

Stage 2: The pharmacist recommends increased ototoxicity monitoring. The client has baseline bilateral hearing loss and uses hearing aids. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
阶段 2：药师建议加强耳毒性监测。患者基线已有双侧听力下降，并使用助听器。哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。
Stage 3: Classify each finding based on how it should affect the nurse's interpretation of the scheduled 0800 vancomycin dose.
阶段 3：根据每项发现对护士解读 0800 预定万古霉素剂量安全性的影响进行分类。

Stage 3: Vancomycin has been held and the antibiotic plan is being changed because of acute kidney injury and new tinnitus. The nurse reviews the medication administration record and sees that lisinopril 10 mg daily is still active and the morning dose has not been given. Potassium is 5.1 mEq/L. What should the nurse do?
阶段 3：因急性肾损伤和新的耳鸣，万古霉素已被暂停，抗生素方案正在更改。护士查看给药记录，发现赖诺普利 10 mg 每日一次仍为有效医嘱，晨间剂量尚未给予。钾为 5.1 mEq/L。护士应怎么做？

Stage 2: The vancomycin trough returns at 22.4 mcg/mL 30 minutes before the next scheduled 1,250 mg dose. The pharmacist recommends a dose reduction and is contacting the infectious disease provider. Arrange the nurse's actions in the safest order.
阶段 2：下一次预定 1,250 mg 剂量前 30 分钟，万古霉素谷浓度返回为 22.4 mcg/mL。药师建议减量，并正在联系感染科医嘱者。请按最安全顺序排列护士的行动。
Document the trough, held dose, notifications, verified new order, and monitoring plan.
记录谷浓度、暂缓给药、通知情况、已核实的新医嘱以及监测计划。
Hold the scheduled 1,250 mg vancomycin dose while the order is being clarified.
在澄清医嘱期间，暂缓预定的 1,250 mg 万古霉素剂量。
Contact the prescriber to confirm the revised dosing order recommended by pharmacy.
联系医嘱者，确认药师建议的修订剂量医嘱。
Administer the revised dose using the ordered premedication and slower infusion precautions.
按已下达的预处理和较慢输注预防措施，给予修订后的剂量。
Verify that the new 1,000 mg vancomycin order is active in the medication administration record.
核实新的 1,000 mg 万古霉素医嘱已在给药记录中生效。
After the corrected order is active, the revised dose may be given with the prior flushing precautions.
纠正后的医嘱生效后，可结合既往潮红反应的预防措施给予修订剂量。
Holding first prevents avoidable accumulation while the unsafe current order is being revised.
首先暂缓给药可在不安全的现有医嘱被修订期间避免药物继续蓄积。
Verification in the MAR prevents administering from an old or unentered order.
在给药记录中核实可防止按旧医嘱或未录入医嘱给药。
The nurse must obtain prescriber clarification rather than independently changing the dose.
护士必须取得医嘱者澄清，而不是自行改变剂量。
Documentation follows the clinical actions and creates a clear record of the abnormal level, hold, communication, and follow-up monitoring.
记录应在临床行动之后进行，清楚说明异常浓度、暂缓给药、沟通和后续监测。

A supratherapeutic trough in a client with impaired renal clearance makes the current scheduled dose unsafe to administer without clarification. The nurse should hold the dose, obtain the revised provider order, verify it in the MAR, administer only the corrected regimen with the ordered precautions, and document the safety actions and monitoring plan.
肾清除功能受损的患者出现超治疗范围谷浓度时，若不澄清医嘱，当前预定剂量不安全。护士应暂缓给药，取得医嘱者修订医嘱，在给药记录中核实后，仅按纠正后的方案和已下达预防措施给药，并记录安全行动和监测计划。
For ordered-response medication safety items, protect the client first, then clarify the order, verify the corrected order, administer only when safe, and document after action is taken.
药物安全排序题中，先保护患者，再澄清医嘱，核实纠正后的医嘱，确认安全后才给药，最后记录已采取的行动。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy.
stem.zh: 阅读患者记录，并回答关于英语能力有限且新做结肠造口患者安全出院宣教的病例题。

title.en: Safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy
title.zh: 英语能力有限的新结肠造口患者安全出院宣教

summary.en: A 62-year-old Spanish-speaking woman is on postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy for perforated diverticulitis. She speaks and reads only Spanish. Her adult daughter speaks English and Spanish and has been interpreting at the bedside, but the chart contains no documentation of qualified interpreter use or patient teach-back. The surgeon's conditional discharge order requires the patient to demonstrate pouch emptying and wafer changing, identify concerning stoma findings, and explain when to call; caregiver participation may supplement but does not replace patient teach-back unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is documented by the provider.
summary.zh: 一名62岁西班牙语患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口术后第3天。她只会说和读西班牙语。成年女儿会英语和西班牙语，并一直在床旁口译，但病历没有记录使用合格口译员，也没有记录患者本人回教。外科医生的有条件出院医嘱要求患者能演示造口袋排空和底盘更换、识别需担心的造口表现，并说明何时联系医生；照护者可参与补充，但除非医生记录为依赖照护者的出院计划，否则不能替代患者本人回教。

content.en:
Postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy.
History: type 2 diabetes; metformin 1,000 mg twice daily restarted this morning after adequate oral intake and creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; hypertension on lisinopril 10 mg daily; BMI 34.
Language: preferred language Spanish; speaks and reads only Spanish. No qualified interpreter use documented during admission.
Current orders: regular diet as tolerated; ambulate four times daily; saline lock; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone PRN; wound and stoma assessments every shift; begin discharge planning today. WOC nurse consult placed postoperative day 1 but not completed.
Night note: 'Patient educated on ostomy care via daughter interpreting. Patient nodded understanding.' No teach-back documented.
Assessment: T 37.2 C, HR 78, BP 134/82, RR 16, SpO2 97% room air. Abdomen soft, mildly tender, no distension. Midline incision clean, dry, approximated with staples. Stoma round, beefy red, moist, about 3 cm diameter, protrudes about 1 cm. Two-piece cut-to-fit wafer with about 1/8-inch clearance. Pouch contains moderate thick greenish-brown stool. Peristomal skin intact. Pain 3/10 by fingers. Ambulates steadily to bathroom.
Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL; Hgb 11.4 g/dL; platelets 268 ×10³/µL; BUN 14 mg/dL; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; K 4.0 mEq/L; Na 139 mEq/L; glucose 148 mg/dL; albumin 3.1 g/dL. No labs pending.
content.zh:
术后第3天，患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口。
病史：2型糖尿病；确认可经口进食且肌酐0.9 mg/dL后，今晨重新开始二甲双胍1,000 mg每日两次；高血压，服用赖诺普利10 mg每日一次；BMI 34。
语言：首选语言为西班牙语；只会说和读西班牙语。本次住院没有记录使用合格口译员。
当前医嘱：按耐受进普通饮食；每日下床活动4次；静脉留置盐水封管；对乙酰氨基酚按需；羟考酮按需；每班评估伤口和造口；今天开始出院计划。术后第1天已请造口伤口护理护士会诊，但尚未完成。
夜班记录：“通过女儿口译进行了造口护理宣教。患者点头表示理解。”未记录回教。
评估：T 37.2 C，HR 78，BP 134/82，RR 16，室内空气SpO2 97%。腹部软，切口周围轻度压痛，无腹胀。腹中线切口清洁、干燥，钉合良好。造口圆形、鲜红湿润，直径约3 cm，突出约1 cm。两件式可剪裁底盘，造口周围间隙约1/8英寸。造口袋内有中等量浓稠绿褐色粪便。造口周围皮肤完整。患者用手指表示疼痛3/10。可稳步走到卫生间。
实验室：WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL；Hgb 11.4 g/dL；血小板268 ×10³/µL；BUN 14 mg/dL；肌酐0.9 mg/dL；K 4.0 mEq/L；Na 139 mEq/L；血糖148 mg/dL；白蛋白3.1 g/dL。无待出结果。

content.en: The nurse identifies three gaps: no qualified interpreter has been used, no WOC nurse visit has occurred, and the discharge criteria require the patient's independent demonstration and explanation. The daughter offers to continue interpreting and states she will live with the patient after discharge. When the nurse asks the patient through the daughter to describe a normal stoma, the daughter answers, 'It should be red and wet,' and the patient nods. When asked directly in simple English with gestures to show pouch emptying, the patient looks to her daughter and the daughter begins guiding the patient's hands. The nurse requests a qualified Spanish interpreter, available by video within 15 minutes, and pages the WOC nurse, who can arrive by 1000.
content.zh: 护士发现三个缺口：没有使用合格口译员、造口伤口护理护士尚未会诊、出院标准要求患者本人独立演示并说明相关内容。女儿主动提出继续口译，并说出院后会与患者同住。护士通过女儿询问患者正常造口应是什么样，女儿回答：“应该是红色、湿的”，患者点头。护士用简单英语和手势直接请患者演示如何排空造口袋时，患者看向女儿，女儿开始引导患者的手。护士申请合格西班牙语口译员，视频口译15分钟内可用，并呼叫造口伤口护理护士，后者可在1000到达。

title.zh: 第2阶段：1000-1200 造口伤口护理护士宣教
口译协助下的造口宣教

content.en: The WOC nurse teaches with the qualified video interpreter. The patient asks new questions about showering, odor, and eating beans and rice. She says she has been afraid to look at the stoma and has let her daughter handle all pouch care. The WOC nurse supports a gradual first look, then guides independent pouch emptying; the patient performs it correctly on the second attempt. The patient removes the old wafer, inspects intact peristomal skin, cleans the area, and applies a new demonstration wafer with verbal coaching only. Output has increased: the pouch is emptied twice in two hours and output is thinner, yellow-green. Vitals: T 37.1 C, HR 74, BP 130/78, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 2/10. Written ostomy instructions in Spanish and an insurance-compatible vendor list are provided. The nurse documents interpreter ID/language, teaching, return demonstration, and patient verbalization through the interpreter of three warning signs: stoma changes from red to dark purple or black, peristomal skin breakdown, and no output for more than 6 hours with cramping or distension.
content.zh: 造口伤口护理护士通过合格视频口译员进行宣教。患者提出新的问题：是否能淋浴、造口袋是否会有气味、是否能吃豆类和米饭。她说自己一直害怕看造口，并让女儿处理所有造口袋护理。造口伤口护理护士支持她循序渐进地第一次观察造口，然后指导她独立排空造口袋；患者第二次尝试时操作正确。患者取下旧底盘，检查完整的造口周围皮肤，清洁该区域，并仅在口头提示下贴上新的演示底盘。排出量增加：2小时内排空造口袋两次，排出物较稀、呈黄绿色。生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 74，BP 130/78，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛2/10。提供西班牙语书面造口护理说明和保险可接受的供应商清单。护士记录口译员编号/语言、宣教内容、回示演示，以及患者通过口译员说出的三个警示表现：造口由红色变成深紫色或黑色、造口周围皮肤破损、超过6小时无排出并伴腹部绞痛或腹胀。

content.en: The surgeon reviews the WOC documentation and confirms discharge criteria are met. Using the qualified interpreter, the nurse reviews medications, follow-up, diet, activity limits, when to call, and when to seek emergency care. Medications: metformin restarted; lisinopril continued; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone prescription for five days with safe storage and disposal teaching. Follow-up: surgeon in 1 week; outpatient WOC nurse in 2 weeks. Diet: advance slowly, chew thoroughly, and introduce gas-producing foods one at a time. Activity: no lifting greater than 10 lb for 6 weeks per surgeon's order. The patient asks whether to check blood glucose at home. The nurse confirms the home glucometer is available and reviews the primary care provider's target fasting glucose range of 70-130 mg/dL. The daughter participates, but teach-back questions are directed to the patient through the interpreter. The patient correctly verbalizes warning signs, pouch emptying and changing, when to call, and the medication schedule. The nurse provides a 24-hour ostomy-support hotline and confirms two weeks of supplies. Discharge vitals: T 37.0 C, HR 76, BP 128/76, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 1/10. Stoma remains red, moist, and functioning. Discharged home with daughter at 1445.

A 62-year-old Spanish-speaking woman is on postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy for perforated diverticulitis. She speaks and reads only Spanish. Her adult daughter speaks English and Spanish and has been interpreting at the bedside, but the chart contains no documentation of qualified interpreter use or patient teach-back. The surgeon's conditional discharge order requires the patient to demonstrate pouch emptying and wafer changing, identify concerning stoma findings, and explain when to call; caregiver participation may supplement but does not replace patient teach-back unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is documented by the provider.

Postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy.
History: type 2 diabetes; metformin 1,000 mg twice daily restarted this morning after adequate oral intake and creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; hypertension on lisinopril 10 mg daily; BMI 34.
Language: preferred language Spanish; speaks and reads only Spanish. No qualified interpreter use documented during admission.
Current orders: regular diet as tolerated; ambulate four times daily; saline lock; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone PRN; wound and stoma assessments every shift; begin discharge planning today. WOC nurse consult placed postoperative day 1 but not completed.
Night note: 'Patient educated on ostomy care via daughter interpreting. Patient nodded understanding.' No teach-back documented.
Assessment: T 37.2 C, HR 78, BP 134/82, RR 16, SpO2 97% room air. Abdomen soft, mildly tender, no distension. Midline incision clean, dry, approximated with staples. Stoma round, beefy red, moist, about 3 cm diameter, protrudes about 1 cm. Two-piece cut-to-fit wafer with about 1/8-inch clearance. Pouch contains moderate thick greenish-brown stool. Peristomal skin intact. Pain 3/10 by fingers. Ambulates steadily to bathroom.
Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL; Hgb 11.4 g/dL; platelets 268 ×10³/µL; BUN 14 mg/dL; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; K 4.0 mEq/L; Na 139 mEq/L; glucose 148 mg/dL; albumin 3.1 g/dL. No labs pending.

The nurse identifies three gaps: no qualified interpreter has been used, no WOC nurse visit has occurred, and the discharge criteria require the patient's independent demonstration and explanation. The daughter offers to continue interpreting and states she will live with the patient after discharge. When the nurse asks the patient through the daughter to describe a normal stoma, the daughter answers, 'It should be red and wet,' and the patient nods. When asked directly in simple English with gestures to show pouch emptying, the patient looks to her daughter and the daughter begins guiding the patient's hands. The nurse requests a qualified Spanish interpreter, available by video within 15 minutes, and pages the WOC nurse, who can arrive by 1000.

The WOC nurse teaches with the qualified video interpreter. The patient asks new questions about showering, odor, and eating beans and rice. She says she has been afraid to look at the stoma and has let her daughter handle all pouch care. The WOC nurse supports a gradual first look, then guides independent pouch emptying; the patient performs it correctly on the second attempt. The patient removes the old wafer, inspects intact peristomal skin, cleans the area, and applies a new demonstration wafer with verbal coaching only. Output has increased: the pouch is emptied twice in two hours and output is thinner, yellow-green. Vitals: T 37.1 C, HR 74, BP 130/78, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 2/10. Written ostomy instructions in Spanish and an insurance-compatible vendor list are provided. The nurse documents interpreter ID/language, teaching, return demonstration, and patient verbalization through the interpreter of three warning signs: stoma changes from red to dark purple or black, peristomal skin breakdown, and no output for more than 6 hours with cramping or distension.

造口伤口护理护士通过合格视频口译员进行宣教。患者提出新的问题：是否能淋浴、造口袋是否会有气味、是否能吃豆类和米饭。她说自己一直害怕看造口，并让女儿处理所有造口袋护理。造口伤口护理护士支持她循序渐进地第一次观察造口，然后指导她独立排空造口袋；患者第二次尝试时操作正确。患者取下旧底盘，检查完整的造口周围皮肤，清洁该区域，并仅在口头提示下贴上新的演示底盘。排出量增加：2小时内排空造口袋两次，排出物较稀、呈黄绿色。生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 74，BP 130/78，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛2/10。提供西班牙语书面造口护理说明和保险可接受的供应商清单。护士记录口译员编号/语言、宣教内容、回示演示，以及患者通过口译员说出的三个警示表现：造口由红色变成深紫色或黑色、造口周围皮肤破损、超过6小时无排出并伴腹部绞痛或腹胀。
